key_idea: With k <= 10 there are only 1024 answer keys, so try every key and take the worst student score for each.
sketch: Encode each student's answers as a k-bit mask. For every key mask m the score of student x is k - popcount(x xor m); take the minimum over students and maximise over m. O(2^k * n) ~ 1e6 operations. No real pitfalls beyond reading T/F into bits.
